messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Question about the source of your milkweed seeds
messages.text:
Hi Connie,

First off, I'm sorry it took us this long to get back to you. That's not how we like to do things, and we'll do better.

Our swamp milkweed seeds (Asclepias incarnata) are straight species, not cultivars. We source them from milkweed farms in eastern Canada, where they're harvested at the right time, then properly dried and stored.

As for pesticides, the seeds themselves aren't treated. The farms we work with grow milkweed without herbicides, which is part of what makes milkweed farming well-suited to conservation. Straight species, grown without pesticide treatment, is the standard in this niche.

If you'd like to plant more, our seeds are here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
